recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-8115; adding resource-specific bindings would duplicate the shared dosage datatype semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-8115 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy correction saying MedicationAsNeededReason bindings on MedicationDispense, MedicationPrescription, and MedicationStatement dosage asNeeded[x] elements had no reference URL/target value set; its resolution tied the fix to FHIR-8018 and SCT 404684003 Clinical Finding.
initial_application: No FHIR-8115-tagged commit was found. Commit 1d00edee44 added the common dosage-instruction source, a MedicationAsNeededReason example binding that references valueset-medication-as-needed-reason, and the corresponding value set.
additional_context: The current medication dosage elements use DosageDetails, DosageDetails.step.component is Dosage, and Dosage.asNeededFor carries the MedicationAsNeededReason binding. FHIR-8018 records the same Pharmacy vote and value set decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current binding is not dangling: source/datatypes/dosage.xml points to valueset-medication-as-needed-reason, and source/datatypes/valueset-medication-as-needed-reason.xml provides the canonical URL and SNOMED CT 404684003 filter.

related_jiras.note: Seed issue for the same Pharmacy vote to add a MedicationAsNeededReason exemplar value set rooted at SCT 404684003.
Later Dosage asNeeded[x] refactor preserved the MedicationAsNeededReason binding while changing the element shape to asNeeded/asNeededFor.
